name: Moves
description: Moves are the skills of Pokémon in battle. In battle, a Pokémon uses one move each turn. Some moves (including those learned by Hidden Machine) can be used outside of battle as well, usually for the purpose of removing obstacles or exploring new areas.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The identifier for this resource.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The name for this resource.

fields.name: accuracy
fields.description: The percent value of how likely this move is to be successful.

fields.name: effect_chance
fields.description: The percent value of how likely it is this moves effect will happen.

fields.name: pp
fields.description: Power points. The number of times this move can be used.

fields.name: priority
fields.description: A value between -8 and 8. Sets the order in which moves are executed during battle. See [Bulbapedia](http://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Priority) for greater detail.

fields.name: power
fields.description: The base power of this move, or null if it has no fixed base power.

fields.name: contest_combos
fields.description: A detail of normal and super contest combos that require this move.

fields.name: contest_type
fields.description: The type of appeal this move gives a Pokémon when used in a contest.

fields.name: contest_effect
fields.description: The effect the move has when used in a contest.

fields.name: damage_class
fields.description: The type of damage the move inflicts on the target, e.g. physical.

fields.name: effect_entries
fields.description: The effect of this move listed in different languages.

fields.name: effect_changes
fields.description: The list of previous effects this move has had across version groups of the games.

fields.name: learned_by_pokemon
fields.description: List of Pokemon that can learn the move

fields.name: flavor_text_entries
fields.description: The flavor text of this move listed in different languages.

fields.name: generation
fields.description: The generation in which this move was introduced.

fields.name: machines
fields.description: A list of the machines that teach this move.

fields.name: meta
fields.description: Metadata about this move

fields.name: names
fields.description: The name of this resource listed in different languages.

fields.name: past_values
fields.description: A list of move resource value changes across version groups of the game.

fields.name: stat_changes
fields.description: A list of stats this moves effects and how much it effects them.

fields.name: super_contest_effect
fields.description: The effect the move has when used in a super contest.

fields.name: target
fields.description: The type of target that will receive the effects of the attack.

fields.name: type
fields.description: The elemental type of this move.

fields.name: normal
fields.description: A detail of moves this move can be used before or after, granting additional appeal points in contests.

fields.name: super
fields.description: A detail of moves this move can be used before or after, granting additional appeal points in super contests.

fields.name: use_before
fields.description: A list of moves to use before this move.

fields.name: use_after
fields.description: A list of moves to use after this move.

fields.name: flavor_text
fields.description: The localized flavor text for an api resource in a specific language.

fields.name: language
fields.description: The language this name is in.

fields.name: version_group
fields.description: The version group that uses this flavor text.

fields.name: ailment
fields.description: The status ailment this move inflicts on its target.

fields.name: category
fields.description: The category of move this move falls under, e.g. damage or ailment.

fields.name: min_hits
fields.description: The minimum number of times this move hits. Null if it always only hits once.

fields.name: max_hits
fields.description: The maximum number of times this move hits. Null if it always only hits once.

fields.name: min_turns
fields.description: The minimum number of turns this move continues to take effect. Null if it always only lasts one turn.

fields.name: max_turns
fields.description: The maximum number of turns this move continues to take effect. Null if it always only lasts one turn.

fields.name: drain
fields.description: HP drain (if positive) or Recoil damage (if negative), in percent of damage done.

fields.name: healing
fields.description: The amount of hp gained by the attacking Pokemon, in percent of it's maximum HP.

fields.name: crit_rate
fields.description: Critical hit rate bonus.

fields.name: ailment_chance
fields.description: The likelihood this attack will cause an ailment.

fields.name: flinch_chance
fields.description: The likelihood this attack will cause the target Pokémon to flinch.

fields.name: stat_chance
fields.description: The likelihood this attack will cause a stat change in the target Pokémon.

fields.name: change
fields.description: The amount of change.

fields.name: stat
fields.description: The stat being affected.

fields.name: accuracy
fields.description: The percent value of how likely this move is to be successful.

fields.name: effect_chance
fields.description: The percent value of how likely it is this moves effect will take effect.

fields.name: power
fields.description: The base power before the listed version group, or null if power did not change.

fields.name: pp
fields.description: Power points. The number of times this move can be used.

fields.name: effect_entries
fields.description: The effect of this move listed in different languages.

fields.name: type
fields.description: The elemental type of this move.

fields.name: version_group
fields.description: The version group in which these move stat values were in effect.
